cases.blurb: Morning rush hour, industry on, construction starts at 08:00.

cases.name: Winter smog night
cases.blurb: Low wind, heavy regional haze (150 ug/m3), evening trash burning 18:30-21:30.

cases.name: Crop-burning season

cases.name: Monsoon fog morning
cases.blurb: Near-saturated air: hygroscopic growth inflates particle counts.

cases.name: Industrial upset + sensor faults
cases.blurb: North-easterly wind; the boiler stack triples its output 10:00-12:00. Four devices develop faults.
